title: A comic-style investigation into a scam that traps Indians by phone just won a Pulitzer Prize.

sources.text: Bloomberg Media - Bloomberg News Wins 2026 Pulitzer Prize for Illustrated Reporting and Commentary
Scroll.in - Indian illustrator Anand RK, journalist Suparna Sharma win Pulitzer Prize for illustrated reporting

caption:
A comic-style investigation into a scam that traps Indians by phone just won a Pulitzer Prize.

Mumbai-based illustrator Anand RK and Delhi-based journalist Suparna Sharma, working with Bloomberg's Natalie Obiko Pearson, won for 'trAPPed' - a graphic investigation into India's 'digital arrest' scam phenomenon, published by Bloomberg.

Using illustration alongside reporting, the project traced how scammers impersonate law enforcement over video calls to psychologically trap victims - a growing global problem the Pulitzer board cited for using visuals and words together to make it visible.

An Indian illustrator and an Indian journalist took a scam that preys on Indians specifically and turned it into internationally recognized, prize-winning work.
